inj_report.long: Gibbs unsurprisingly had his work cut out for him against the Buccaneers' typically stingy run defense, but the Lions had the luxury of continuing to pound Gibbs into the line while protecting a second-half lead. Gibbs eventually broke through for a game-long 26-yard run and cashed in with one- and four-yard touchdown runs in the fourth quarter to help ice the victory. While Gibbs fell just short of his fifth 100-yard effort in the last six games, the 2023 first-round pick is up to 13 rushing touchdowns and is averaging 5.0 yards per carry heading into a Thanksgiving Day home showdown against the Bears.
inj_report.short: Gibbs rushed 23 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns and secured four of five targets for 20 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

inj_report.long: The Bengals offense started slowly and was shut out altogether in the first quarter, but Burrow was able to lead his team to 10 second-quarter points partly via a 31-yard touchdown pass to Tee Higgins. The prolific signal-caller added a four-yard scoring toss to Colbie Young in the third quarter, and Burrow then helped lead Cincinnati downfield for a go-ahead Evan McPherson 56-yard field goal with 46 seconds remaining, albeit after narrowly avoiding an interception and then taking a third-down sack. Nevertheless, the Bengals came up short when Jayden Daniels led the Commanders on a five-play, 64-yard game-winning march, but Burrow finished with his fourth tally of at least 300 passing yards this season. He'll look to put his team back in the win column in a favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Saints on Sunday.
inj_report.short: Burrow completed 28 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed twice for minus-1 yard in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.

inj_report.long: Daniels looked like he was on his way to a middling night during a first half in which he led the Commanders to just seven points, but the 2024 first-round pick flipped a switch in the second half, particularly in the fourth quarter. Daniels led field-goal drives of 13, 11 and five plays that netted a total of 193 yards during the final period, the last one featuring strikes of 22 and 42 yards to Antonio Williams to position Drew Stevens for a game-winning field goal. Daniels finished with his second-highest passing yardage total of the season, and he also mustered his seventh interception-free effort of the campaign. Having helped Washington to a critical victory, he'll look to carry the momentum over into a favorable Week 12 road matchup against the Cardinals on Sunday.
inj_report.short: Daniels completed 23 of 35 passes for 289 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and added six carries for 55 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.

The 2023 first-round pick went on to toss three touchdown passes for the second straight game and multiple scores for the fifth consecutive contest overall. Stroud connected with Nico Collins (42 yards), Kayshon Boutte (24 yards) and Marlin Klein (13 yards) for his trio of scoring strikes, and he'll take a sparkling 22:4 TD:INT into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.
inj_report.short: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

inj_report.long: As the final score and Prescott's numbers indicate, the prolific passer was clicking on all cylinders right out of the gate against an overmatched Titans defense. Prescott had already helped stake the Cowboys to a 27-6 lead by halftime with eight- and 10-yard touchdown strikes to CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, respectively. Prescott struck again through the air in the second half with an 11-yard touchdown pass to Javonte Williams before closing out his touchdown tally with a two-yard toss to Brevyn Spann-Ford with just under five minutes remaining. Prescott added his second rushing touchdown of the campaign on a two-yard run in the latter portion of the third quarter, giving him his second straight five-TD performance. Prescott is up to 3,049 passing yards and a 25:6 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day home clash with the Eagles in Week 12.
inj_report.short: Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added four carries for nine yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

inj_report.long: Irving worked hard all afternoon against a feisty Lions defense, and outside of his game-long 23-yard run, he scuffled to 45 yards on 17 carries. Irving worked around a hard shot to the abdomen that he sustained in the second half, and he did manage to contribute a rushing touchdown for the fourth straight game when he went in from one yard out in the latter portion of the third quarter. Irving has now equaled a career high with eight rushing touchdowns, and he's 107 yards short of his second career 1,000-yard season on the ground heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Panthers on Monday night, Nov. 30.
inj_report.short: Irving rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 32 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Allen completed 27 of 45 passes for 304 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.

Skattebo also committed another untimely turnover, fumbling at Jacksonville's 31-yard line with just over four minutes remaining in the third quarter and New York trying to add to a 20-6 lead. The change of possession ultimately didn't lead to any Jaguars points, however, and head coach John Harbaugh showed some faith in the second-year back by affording him the opportunity to ice the upset win with three carries on the final drive. Skattebo proved up to the task by netting 13 yards on those touches to force the Jags to exhaust their timeouts, and he should continue helming the backfield in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

inj_report.long: Smith didn't have a completion longer than 21 yards but kept the offense on schedule with an accurate performance. inj_report.long: Taylor is slated to take his first extended snaps alongside Richardson since the 2024 season, when the two started together 10 times. The threat that Richardson presented to defenses as a runner seemed to aid Taylor's own effectiveness, as the running back averaged 4.8 yards per carry and scored eight touchdowns over that 10-game stretch. Now two years later, the Colts have a much less formidable offensive line in place and few established pass-catching weapons that defenses need to hone in on, so Taylor will likely be hard-pressed to match the lofty production he previously achieved with Richardson under center. Additionally, the 3-8 Colts may be cognizant of not overworking Taylor amid a losing season, though the loss of top backup Seth McGowan (hamstring) for at least Week 12 may result in Taylor seeing a slight uptick in opportunities after he played fewer than 70 percent of snaps in each of the last five games and averaged 16.6 touches in those contests.
inj_report.short: Taylor will be joined in the backfield in Sunday's game against the Giants by Anthony Richardson, who was named the Colts' new starting quarterback after Daniel Jones was cut Friday, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

inj_report.long: Williams had already been losing ground to Blake Corum in recent weeks, but the latter's takeover of the ground attack may have been finalized Wednesday with his career-best 184-yard, one-touchdown effort. Williams logged his final three carries on the Rams' final drive, but Corum was in the clear lead role throughout the majority of the night. Williams did add his seventh rushing touchdown of the campaign on a seven-yard run early in the second quarter, and his backseat role may have been influenced in part by the turf toe injury he's been dealing with for the past month. Nonetheless, Williams could be destined for a true complementary role if McVay opts to center the ground game on Corum moving forward.
inj_report.short: Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night.

inj_report.long: Stevenson hurt his knee in Week 9 against Green Bay and initially appeared slated to miss multiple games. However, he surprisingly was able to suit up in Week 10 against Detroit in Munich, Germany, though he logged just a 44 percent offensive snap share and gained only five yards on seven touches. Stevenson is now off the injury report entirely to begin Week 12 prep following New England's Week 11 bye, suggesting that the knee issue is no longer a concern. The veteran running back commented Wednesday on his ability to suit up in Week 10, attributing it to "a bunch of recovery" and sharing, "(The trainers) did a good job of just getting me available again... Leg wasn't feeling 100 percent, but I was well enough to go out there and participate with the team and try to help them out a little bit," per Sophie Weller of Patriots Wire. With no practice restrictions to begin Week 12 prep, Stevenson should be set to suit up this Sunday  in Los Angeles against the Chargers, when he'll be taking handoffs from QB Tommy DeVito.

inj_report.long: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in their first game together. Milton is poised to start on Thanksgiving against the Cowboys, with whom he appeared in four games last season. He was on Dallas' practice squad prior to signing with the Eagles in October.
inj_report.short: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.

inj_report.long: After a hit-or-miss first six appearances of the season, Nix has settled into a four-game stretch in which his passing yards have ranged from 222 to 237 weekly, a span in which he boasts a 6:2 TD:INT and 84 rushing yards and another score. He also displayed some promise with offseason acquisition Jaylen Waddle (3-61-0 on six targets) while connecting with TE Adam Trautman for his 12th touchdown pass in 10 contests. Nix will look to keep things rolling Friday at Pittsburgh.
inj_report.short: Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception and notched six carries for five yards during Sunday's 38-24 victory against the Raiders.

inj_report.long: With Drake Maye (fibula) hurt early in Week 10 against Detroit, DeVito stepped in at quarterback but managed to complete just 12 of 24 pass attempts for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception. He added 19 yards on four carries. The 28-year-old does have some starting experience -- he helmed the Giants offense for eight starts between 2023 and 2024 -- but he didn't play at all in 2025. For now, the Patriots are at least communicating that they'll stand pat and not look for help at quarterback outside the organization. However, the team is barely hanging on in the AFC playoff race with a 5-5 record, and with only rookie Behren Morton on the active roster as a healthy option to DeVito, the team may still look elsewhere if DeVito is unable to show better production.
inj_report.short: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that DeVito is the team's starting quarterback, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports. "We're excited about that. He had a good preseason, and Tommy's improved," Vrabel said of DeVito.

inj_report.long: Playing his second game without both Puka Nacua (IR, knee/toe) and Davante Adams (IR, hamstring), Stafford saw a notable downturn in his numbers and posted a new season low in passing yards. The veteran signal-caller also threw an interception for the fifth straight game, although his pick Wednesday didn't lead to any Packers points since Los Angeles intercepted Jordan Love just two plays later. Stafford also failed to throw a touchdown pass for only the second time this season, and the fact he also lost tight ends Tyler Higbee (chest) and Davis Allen (ankle) to in-game injuries didn't help his cause. On the positive side, there's an outside chance Stafford has Adams back in the fold for a Week 13 home showdown against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3.
inj_report.short: Stafford completed 16 of 23 passes for 141 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed once for no gain in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night. He also committed a fumble recovered by Los Angeles.

inj_report.long: Late Tuesday, the Steelers opted to make a change under center, naming Rudolph the Week 12 starter and sending Rodgers to the bench on the heels of poor performances by the offense in back-to-back losses to the Bengals and Eagles coming out of a bye week. The Steelers initially planned to make Rodgers inactive for Week 12 but keep him on the roster, but the team now intends to part ways with the four-time MVP after he harshly criticized head coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" on Wednesday. The impending departure of Rodgers should thus give Rudolph an extended leash as the Steelers' starter, with a pair of inexperienced quarterbacks in second-year man Will Howard and rookie third-round pick Drew Allar representing the other options behind him on the depth chart. Over 38 career appearances (19 starts), the 31-year-old Rudolph has completed 64.2 percent of his passes for 6.6 yards per attempt and a 30:22 TD:INT.
inj_report.short: Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos and could remain atop the depth chart for the rest of the season with the Steelers waiving Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday.

Penix has now tossed six interceptions in the last three games, however, and he'll look to regroup during the Week 11 bye before tackling a difficult matchup against the Vikings on the road on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.long: Corum's stock had already been trending firmly up in recent weeks, but Wednesday may ultimately go down as the day he formally took the reins of the ground attack from Kyren Williams. The 2024 third-round pick compiled a career-best rushing total while also becoming the first Rams running back to reach the 30-carry threshold in a game during the Sean McVay era that began in 2017. Corum has now logged double-digit carries in five consecutive games, and he capped off his night with productive runs of seven, nine and 29 yards on Los Angeles' game-sealing drive. Corum's fantasy value naturally skyrocketed with Wednesday's performance, and he'll look to build on the outstanding performance in a Week 13 home matchup against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3.
inj_report.short: Corum rushed 32 times for 184 yards and a touchdown and brought in two of three targets for 21 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday. He also recovered a fumble.

The veteran tight end saw Christian Watson exit the game twice with thigh and head injuries in the first half, the latter issue forcing his exit for the rest of the game. inj_report.long: Making his return from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, Montgomery functioned as the clear lead back with Woody Marks (concussion) unavailable. The former put together the best rushing yardage total of his brief Texans tenure, handling his highest number of carries since Week 4 of his 2023 debut campaign with the Lions. Montgomery also was encouragingly involved in a complementary role in the passing game, and he'll now have some extra time to recover from Thursday's workload ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29. However, if Marks is able to clear concussion protocol ahead of that contest, Montgomery will see his touch count take a hit.

inj_report.long: The Commanders' defense focused its attention toward slowing down both Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins. That opened up the field for Perine, with most of his production coming on a 44-yard catch late in the second quarter, and the drive ended two plays later with a 31-yard touchdown pass from Joe Burrow to Higgins. Perine finished second on the Bengals in both catches and receiving yards behind tight end Mike Gesicki, and the RB's 26 rushing yards were well ahead of Chase Brown's six. Perine has at least 10 touches in each of his last three games, but Cincinnati's offense is mustering only 79.4 rushing yards per game, which is third-worst in the NFL. Given Brown's struggles this season, Perine could take on a larger role in the backfield for Week 12 against the Saints on Sunday.
inj_report.short: Perine turned six carries into 26 yards and caught all four of his targets for 71 yards during the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday.

inj_report.long: The rookie third-round pick managed new career highs across all three components of his receiving line, which also all served as team-best totals Monday. Williams' last two catches of the night were his most critical, as he recorded 22- and 42-yard grabs on Washington's final drive to position Drew Stevens for a game-winning 26-yard field goal. Williams hadn't topped 54 receiving yards in any game after a 64-yard effort in his pro debut in Week 1, but Monday night's breakout could serve as a launchpad to a strong stretch run as the Commanders make a playoff push.
inj_report.short: Williams brought in nine of 11 targets for 122 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.

It may signal that Charbonnet is the Seahawks' clear-cut No. 1 backfield option moving forward, but he won't have a chance to prove as much until after the team's Week 11 bye on Sunday, Nov. 29, at San Francisco.
inj_report.short: Charbonnet churned out 94 yards on 20 carries during Sunday's 21-13 win in Las Vegas.

Mumpfield should retain a solid No. 2 role even if Davante Adams (IR, hamstring) returns for a Week 13 home matchup against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3, and the former will retain his No. 1 standing if his star teammate remains sidelined.

Pitts' fumble, his first of the season, came with just over four minutes remaining in the game after the contest was out of reach, and his catch total was his highest since Week 7. Pitts remains a key complementary option in an Atlanta passing attack that's scuffled of late, and he'll look to bounce back after the Falcons emerge from a Week 11 bye with a Week 12 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.
inj_report.short: Pitts brought in four of five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

inj_report.long: The veteran tight end finished with a team-high yardage total while coming just a yard short of equaling his best tally of the season as well. Gesicki's biggest catch came late in the fourth quarter on the Bengals' final drive, when he hauled in a 32-yard pass from Joe Burrow over the middle to get the Bengals down to  the Commanders' 33-yard line. Gesicki's production continues to have some game-to-game volatility, but he'll draw another favorable matchup in a Week 12 home clash with the Saints on Sunday.
inj_report.short: Gesicki brought in five of six targets for 77 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.

inj_report.short: Andrews caught two of three targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to Carolina.

Most of the wide receiver's production came on a 39-yard catch in the fourth quarter, and he has now combined to reel in three of 12 targets for 59 yards over Mendoza's first two career starts.
inj_report.short: Tucker caught two of 10 targets for 50 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.

inj_report.long: Metcalf was disqualified with 4:53 remaining in the third quarter Sunday after he attempted to poke Eagles defensive back Cooper DeJean in the eye. He was flagged for unsportsmanlike conduct in what was his second major transgression of the game; Metcalf previously drew an unnecessary roughness penalty in the first half, when he held his block of DeJean well after a play had finished. Though Metcalf won't miss further game action as a result of his ejection, he may have already lost the faith of his fantasy managers heading into a Week 12 matchup with the Broncos on Friday. Metcalf has hauled in just 36 of his 74 targets (48.6 percent catch rate) and has scored just two touchdowns on the season while topping 60 receiving yards in only two of his 10 appearances.
inj_report.short: Metcalf won't receive a suspension after he was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, but the NFL is still reviewing discipline for the receiver that could include a fine, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

inj_report.long: With Michael Pittman (foot) remaining sidelined for Week 11, Bernard retained his every-down role on offense, playing 67 of 71 offensive snaps while leading the team in routes (52) and targets. Pittman is expected back for Friday's game against the Broncos, but Bernard could keep pacing the team in playing time, especially if DK Metcalf gets disciplined for his latest on-field outburst.
inj_report.short: Bernard caught six passes for 40 yards on 10 targets in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

Brooks is poised to remain a full practice participant leading up to Monday's game at Tampa Bay, but he doesn't appear to be a lock to get activated from IR for that contest. Canales noted that Chuba Hubbard has thrived of late as the Panthers' lead back, while Trevor Etienne is coming off a positive showing as the top complement to Hubbard in this past Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens. Meanwhile, Anthony Tyus has carved out a role as Carolina's kickoff returner, and AJ Dillon looms as a fourth option at running back. Given the crowding in the Carolina backfield along with his lack of contributions on special teams, Brooks may need to look impressive in practice this week for the Panthers to justify adding him back to the 53-man roster.

inj_report.short: Moreau brought in his lone target for eight yards during the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

inj_report.long: The Patriots lost starting quarterback Drake Maye to an ankle injury early in the first quarter, so backup Tommy DeVito was under center for most of contest. New England struggled with DeVito at the helm, but he did connect with Larison for a 10-yard touchdown pass early in the fourth quarter in what was the Patriots' lone trip to the end zone. Even though that score came in garbage time, it was the first touchdown of Larison's NFL career, although he's firmly entrenched as the team's RB3 behind Rhamondre Stevenson and Corey Kiner. The Patriots are on a bye for Week 11, so their next game will take place in Week 12 against the Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 29.
inj_report.short: Larison turned his lone carry into two yards and caught two of three targets for 15 yards and a touchdown during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle on special teams.

inj_report.long: Wallace began the season on the Cardinals' practice squad and didn't play in his first NFL game until Week 9 versus Seattle. After logging a total of seven offensive snaps and one catch across his first two contests, the rookie paced Arizona wideouts in targets, receptions and receiving yards. Wallace also ranked second among the wideout corps with 36 offensive snaps, so it appears there was a conscious effort to involve him in the team's passing game. The Cardinals' wide-receiver room has lacked a reliable option since Michael Wilson went down with a season-ending neck injury, so the door is wide open for Wallace to claim a prominent role with continued production.
inj_report.short: Wallace finished Sunday's loss to Kansas City with four catches for 57 yards on seven targets.

Jones finished the game with a one-yard carry and a 17-yard catch on two targets, and that reception ended up being the second-longest offensive play for the Cardinals. Given his usage in Week 11, Jones stands a good chance of being brought up for Week 12 against the Commanders on Nov. 29, although his next elevation from the practice squad is the last one he is eligible for this season.
inj_report.short: Jones reverted to the Cardinals' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

inj_report.long: Bellinger played 26 offensive snaps and five special-teams snaps in the contest. The tight end capitalized on his sole target but was primarily utilized as a blocker in the blowout loss.
inj_report.short: Bellinger made one catch for five yards in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

inj_report.long: With T.J. Hockenson back in the lineup after being inactive Week 10, Bartholomew played just 18 of 67 offensive snaps as the Vikings' third tight end, also behind Ben Yurosek. Bartholomew has 11 catches for 95 yards and a touchdown on 15 targets across 10 games this season.
inj_report.short: Bartholomew caught one of three targets for five yards in Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.

inj_report.long: One of Wright's two grabs in Week 11 was a 27-yard strike up the seam, easily his longest reception of the season thus far. He was on the field for 43 of the Lions' 58 offensive snaps Sunday, but he spent a substantial majority of those on blocking assignments for tailback Jahmyr Gibbs and company. His role in a Thanksgiving tilt versus the Bears may depend somewhat on the health of running mate Sam LaPorta, who was limited during Monday's walkthrough with an ankle issue.
inj_report.short: Wright caught both of two targets for 42 yards during Sunday's 31-21 win versus the Buccaneers.

inj_report.long: With DK Metcalf ejected in the second half of Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, Hurleman ended up playing 22 of 71 offensive snaps after getting bumped up from the practice squad to make his NFL debut. The  25-year-old saw seven targets, finishing with six receptions for 61 yards and the Steelers' lone touchdown of the contest. He also displaced Kaden Wetjen on the Steelers' return units, bringing back two kickoffs for 32 yards and three punts for 36 yards. Expect Hurleman to get elevated from the practice squad again in Friday's game against the Broncos.
inj_report.short: Hurleman reverted to the Steelers' practice squad Monday.

inj_report.long: Watkins may have injured his groin during the 49ers' 35-10 win over the Vikings in Week 11, when he hauled in his lone target for 19 yards while playing 28 snaps on offense. His practice participation over the next two days will shed light on his status heading into Sunday's NFC West tilt against the Seahawks. If Watkins cannot play in Week 12, then Keenan Allen, Jacob Cowing and Demarcus Robinson would all be in line for larger roles on offense.
inj_report.short: Watkins (groin) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.

The fourth-year tight end out of South Carolina has mainly served as a blocking specialist for Denver, having thus far been limited to a 7-47-3 receiving line on nine targets to go with a six-yard carry through 10 appearances on the season.
inj_report.short: Adkins recorded a three-yard reception on two targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

inj_report.long: Watkins played just five offensive snaps for the Colts in Thursday night's game. Despite playing only 10 percent of the offensive snaps, Watkins totaled the third-highest yardage by Colts pass catchers on the night with his 26-yard grab. The reserve wide receiver could see an expanded role down the stretch as the Colts experiment with starting quarterback Anthony Richardson in what is all but a lost season.
inj_report.short: Watkins caught one of his three targets for 26 yards during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.

After the two-score effort, Quitoriano logged double-digit snaps on offense in four straight contests, but he drew just one target over that stretch. In the subsequent two games, Quitoriano has played just three total snaps on offense while Trey McBride, Elijah Higgins and Hunter Long have been prioritized ahead of him at tight end.
inj_report.short: Quitoriano played all 13 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.

inj_report.long: Chig Okonkwo was the Commanders' only tight end who produced offensively Monday, with the fifth-year pro catching four of five passes for 66 yards. Sinnott has been targeted zero times in seven of 10 regular-season games, with his lone productive outing being Week 10 against the Giants, when he brought in all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown. He brings very little fantasy appeal heading into Washington's Week 12 road tilt against Arizona on Sunday.
inj_report.short: Sinnott played played 33 snaps (24 on offense, nine on special teams) but didn't show up in the box score otherwise during the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday.

inj_report.long: Per Reiss, teams are limited to eight players that can be designated to return from the list over the course of the regular season, and the Patriots are close to using them all. "Right now, he's not on injured reserve," Vrabel said Monday. "He's on the active roster, so that's where it is today. I think that those things are obviously fluid. But we want to try to give him every opportunity that we can to be back at some point in time. I don't know when that will be; I'm not sure. But also, try to manage the roster and do what we need to do to try to win each week." On Sunday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported that Maye was on track to miss at least six weeks, a timetable that suggests, in a best-case scenario, the QB could make a push for a late-season return or for the postseason, should New England qualify. Heading into a Week 12 game against the Chargers, Tommy DeVito is slated to work as the team's starter, with rookie Behren Morton on hand as his backup. Additionally, there's the possibility that the team considers Daniel Jones -- who the Colts let go Friday -- as an alternative, but Vrabel told Reiss that in the short term at least, adding another signal-caller is not something that's being planned.
inj_report.short: For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

Bates led the league in PATs in the 2024 and 2025 seasons and is again on pace to kick 50-plus extra points in 2026.

inj_report.long: The Saints didn't have a scoring drive until the second quarter, when Smyth made his season-long, 56-yard field goal to cut the lead going into halftime, his first of two 50-plus-yard FGs in the game. The 25-year-old also continued his perfect PAT percentage for the season, making his singular attempt (5-for-5 in three games). His play on kickoffs stood out Sunday, committing two penalties for kicking the ball out of bounds and giving Chicago excellent field position.
inj_report.short: Smyth made two of three field-goal attempts and his lone PAT in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.

inj_report.long: Reichard failed to get the Vikings on the board in the first quarter after his 55-yard field-goal attempt missed to the left. He had the stadium's altitude in his favor when lining up for a 71-yarder on the final play of the first half, but what would have been an NFL record-breaking kick fell just short. Reichard is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts through 10 regular-season games, and each of those misses have come from 50-plus yards. The Vikings will be home in a controlled environment for three of their next four games, starting in Week 12 against the Falcons on Nov. 29.
inj_report.short: Reichard went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point try during Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers in Mexico City.

inj_report.long: Shrader opened Thursday's scoring with a 34-yard field goal early in the first quarter. Those ended up being the only three points scored by the Colts, as Shrader missed a 56-yarder later in the quarter, and his 62-yarder in the second quarter was blocked by Logan Hall. It was the second time this season that Shrader has missed two kicks, and the third-year kicker now is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts (including 9-for-12 on kicks from 50-plus yards) and 19-for-20 on extra-point tries through 11 regular-season games. His scoring potential figures to be lower for the rest of the season after the Colts waived Daniel Jones on Friday, which paves the way for Anthony Richardson to start under center in Week 12 against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.
inj_report.short: Shrader went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.

He's now 18-for-19 on field-goal tries and has made all 17 PATs through 10 games. Kicking in one of the lower-scoring offenses in the league, it still doesn't translate to much fantasy appeal for Slye ahead of next Sunday's road date with the Jaguars.
inj_report.short: Slye made all three field-goal attempts and went 3-for-3 on PATs in Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.

inj_report.long: After making multiple field goals in four straight games leading up to Sunday's game, McLaughlin didn't attempt a field goal for just the second time this season. The veteran kicker remains perfect on 43 kicks this season, going 22-for-22 on field goals and 21-for-21 on PATs. He's a valuable fantasy kicker headed into next Monday night's home date with the Panthers.
inj_report.short: McLaughlin made all three of his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.

inj_report.long: Bass was able to make at least three field goals for the fifth time in the team's last six contests. The kicker made field goals from 43 and 54 yards in the first half before adding makes from 40 and 28 yards in the fourth quarter. His lone miss of the day came in the third quarter, when he pulled a 54-yard try wide left, registering his first missed field-goal try of the year. Bass has now gone 24-for-25 on field-goal attempts, including 4-for-5 from 50-plus yards, over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.
inj_report.short: Bass went 4-for-5 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.

inj_report.long: After both teams went scoreless in a rainy first quarter, McPherson put the Bengals on the board with a 38-yard field goal in the second. He nailed a 56-yarder late in the fourth to give the Bengals a 20-19 lead, but his would-be game winner didn't come to pass as the Commanders raced down the field to set up Drew Stevens for a 26-yard field goal to seal the win for Washington. McPherson has made only five field goals (on six attempts) over the Bengals' last five games, but his 35 point-afters are second-most in the NFL behind Eddy Pineiro (36). The Bengals will head back home for Week 12 against the Saints, whose defense ranks 23rd in the NFL in points allowed per game (25.7).
inj_report.short: McPherson made both of his field-goal attempts and went 2-for-2 on extra-point tries during the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday.

inj_report.long: Patterson was able to convert his only field-goal try in Week 11, nailing a chip-shot 28-yard attempt in the first quarter. He's now combined to go 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts while making all six of his PATs over two contests as the starting kicker for Baltimore, and he likely will remain in that role for Week 12 with Tyler Loop (groin) sidelined for at least one more contest.
inj_report.short: Patterson made his only field-goal attempt and went 4-for-4 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.

inj_report.long: Dicker's field goal was drilled from 52 yards, and he's now 19-for-21 on field-goal tries and 15-for-15 on extra points through 10 games this season. In a Chargers offense struggling mightily to score points, Dicker's fantasy value has tanked this season.
inj_report.short: Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt and all three PATs in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
